title: the WSG good sleep vs bad sleep and fire slice with Table 38 - the rest-quality penalty ladder and the longer-sleep compensation, the armor donning and doffing discipline, the campfire sizes and the warmth-at-distance grid, printed p. 65
audit_label: R474 WSG rest quality and fire pin audit
audit_comment: The Table 38 grids (the three fire sizes by fuel, start dice, refuel, wind resistance, capacity and visibility, plus the warmth-at-distance ladder with the dash-as-no-warmth sentinel), the eight rest-quality penalties with the plate-armor waivers, the no-rest threshold, the extreme-weather bar, the longer-sleep compensation, the armor donning and doffing discipline and the fire-function prose are audit examples.

banner.title: R474: the WSG GOOD SLEEP VS BAD SLEEP and FIRE slice with TABLE 38 - the rest-quality penalty ladder (not prone or relaxed 1; bare ground 1, waived for a plate wearer; personal temperature below 0 one hour and above 90 two hours; wind of 20 mph or greater with no shelter 2, likewise waived; light or moderate precipitation with no shelter 3, likewise waived; any metal armor except plate 3; any plate armor 4) with the DM-summed reduction, the no-rest threshold when the total penalty exceeds the time spent trying to sleep, the extreme-weather bar (no sleep in a lightning storm, a hailstorm or a sandstorm unless inside a shelter, and even then the commotion may keep him awake), the longer-sleep compensation (a plate wearer five-hour night buys one hour of good rest, nine hours refresh like five), the sleep-in-armor prudence with the one-night-in-two rule, the armor donning discipline (9 minus AC rounds, plus 2 for any plate, plus 5 more unaided for field or full plate: leather 1, banded 5, full plate 11 helped or 16 solo, doffing in half the time with 8 rounds to shed full plate alone) and the fire function (cooking incidental, warmth primary, three sizes) with Table 38 (fuel 6/12/18 turns for an eight-hour burn, start 2d20 plus 0/5/10, refuel 3/6/9, wind resistance 20/30/40, capacity 6/10/15, visibility 240/360/540, and the warmth-at-distance ladder by size and range), printed p. 65.
banner.provenance: Ground truth two-way on the prose and the Table 38 top grid, no physical-page reads: the user-run Termux tesseract text of printed p. 65 (p65_full.txt, p65_tsv.tsv) vs the pdf embedded text layer (pdftotext -layout, pdf page 66, p65_pdfy.txt). The two readers AGREE on all prose numbers: the eight penalty values (tesseract garbles only the minus signs on four of the eight lines, never the digits), the DM-summed reduction and the no-rest threshold, the three storm types, the 5/1 and 9/5 plate-sleep figures, the one-night-in-two rule, the 9-minus-AC donning base with the 2 and 5 round adds, the 1/5/11/16 donning figures with the half-time doffing at 8 rounds, the cooking-incidental and warmth-primary prose, and the Table 38 top grid (fuel 6/12/18, start 2d20 +0/+5/+10, refuel 3/6/9, res 20/30/40, cap 6/10/15, vis 240/360/540). For the WARMTH-AT-DISTANCE grid tesseract garbles four cells into low-confidence noise: the Small row at 50 and 60 yards (reading 00 and 10) and the Large row at 20 and 60 yards (reading 4 and O). The pdf layer reads them as 0, 0, 40 and 0, and the TSV WORD-BOX GEOMETRY (the R467 workflow) settles them: the Small at-60 box is 20 pixels wide like every single-digit cell (a true 10 is 39 wide), the Large at-20 box is 40 pixels wide exactly like every two-digit 40 cell (a lone 4 is 19 wide), and the Large at-60 box is a single glyph. The grid is also internally consistent: every row decays monotonically with distance, and at every shared distance a larger fire warms at least as much as a smaller one. NOTE: the standing vision-on-png contested-cell settler was tried twice on this page and failed both times - each vision read contradicted the two agreeing text layers on uncontested cells (reading the refuel column as the start dice and inventing dashes mid-row), so the TSV geometry plus monotonicity is the settler of record this round.
banner.sentinel: All 27 warmth-grid cells pinned (the three sizes by nine distances, with 999 marking the three printed dashes as no warmth at that distance: a medium fire provides none at 1, a large fire none at 1 or 3); the 24 top-grid cells, the eight penalties, the armor timing figures and the book own plate-sleep and donning examples are audit examples.

consts.name: wgfPenNotProne
consts.comment: the rest-quality penalty for a character not prone or in a relaxed position: 1 hour of good rest lost

consts.name: wgfPenBareGround
consts.comment: the penalty for lying on bare ground with no bedding or padding: 1 hour lost (waived for a plate-armor wearer)

consts.name: wgfPenTempBelow0
consts.comment: the penalty for personal temperature below 0 degrees: 1 hour lost

consts.name: wgfPenTempAbove90
consts.comment: the penalty for personal temperature above 90 degrees: 2 hours lost

consts.name: wgfPenWindNoShelter
consts.comment: the penalty for wind of 20 mph or greater with no shelter: 2 hours lost (waived for a plate-armor wearer)

consts.name: wgfPenPrecipNoShelter
consts.comment: the penalty for light or moderate precipitation with no shelter: 3 hours lost (waived for a plate-armor wearer)

consts.name: wgfPenMetalArmor
consts.comment: the penalty for wearing any metal armor except plate: 3 hours lost

consts.name: wgfPenPlateArmor
consts.comment: the penalty for wearing any kind of plate armor: 4 hours lost

consts.name: wgfPlateTypicalNight
consts.comment: the plate-armor sleeper bedding down for a typical night of five hours

consts.name: wgfPlateNightGoodRest
consts.comment: a five-hour night in plate armor yields the equivalent of one hour of actual rest

consts.name: wgfPlateLongSleep
consts.comment: sleeping nine hours in plate armor instead

consts.name: wgfPlateLongRefresh
consts.comment: nine hours in plate refreshes like five hours with the armor off

consts.name: wgfDonBase
consts.comment: the armor donning base: subtract the armor class from 9 to get the rounds to put it on

consts.name: wgfPlateAddRounds
consts.comment: any plate armor (bronze plate mail, plate mail, field plate or full plate) adds 2 rounds to the calculated figure

consts.name: wgfUnaidedAddRounds
consts.comment: field plate or full plate donned without help adds an extra 5 rounds

consts.name: wgfLeatherAC
consts.comment: leather armor is AC 8

consts.name: wgfLeatherDonRounds
consts.comment: leather armor (AC 8) can be donned in one round

consts.name: wgfBandedAC
consts.comment: banded mail is AC 4

consts.name: wgfBandedDonRounds
consts.comment: banded mail (AC 4) requires five rounds

consts.name: wgfFullPlateAC
consts.comment: full plate armor is AC 0

consts.name: wgfFullPlateHelpedRounds
consts.comment: full plate armor (AC 0) needs 11 rounds with the help of a comrade

consts.name: wgfFullPlateSoloRounds
consts.comment: full plate armor needs 16 rounds singlehandedly

consts.name: wgfFullPlateSoloDoffRounds
consts.comment: taking off a suit of full plate armor without help takes 8 rounds (half of 16)

consts.name: wgfFireSizes
consts.comment: a campfire can be built in one of three sizes

consts.name: wgfBurnHours
consts.comment: the fuel values gather enough material to keep a fire of that size burning for eight hours

bools.name: wgfQualityNotNight
bools.comment: a good night rest speaks to the quality of the rest, not the night

bools.name: wgfComfortRequired
bools.comment: to fully benefit from his sleeping time a character must be able to rest in comfort, which is not always easy in the wilderness

bools.name: wgfPenaltiesSummed
bools.comment: the Dungeon Master adds up all of the penalties that apply and reduces the hours of sleep by the indicated amount

bools.name: wgfNoRestWhenExceeded
bools.comment: if the total penalty exceeds the time the character spends trying to sleep, the resting did him no good at all

bools.name: wgfStarPenaltiesSkipPlate
bools.comment: the starred penalties (bare ground, wind and precipitation) do not apply to a character wearing plate armor

bools.name: wgfExtremeWeatherNoSleep
bools.comment: it is impossible to sleep in extreme weather such as a lightning storm, a hailstorm or a sandstorm unless the character is inside a shelter

bools.name: wgfStormCommotionCaveat
bools.comment: even inside a shelter the commotion caused by the storm may keep him awake

bools.name: wgfDmMayExpandPenalties
bools.comment: the Dungeon Master may expand the penalty list to account for other circumstances where good-quality rest is difficult or impossible

bools.name: wgfLongerSleepCompensates
bools.comment: one way to compensate for bad rest is to spend a longer time sleeping

bools.name: wgfArmorSleepPrudent
bools.comment: if characters might be set upon during the night, sleeping in full armor is probably more prudent than taking it off

bools.name: wgfOneNightInTwoSuffices
bools.comment: because the lack-of-sleep penalties do not go into effect until after the second night of deprivation, enough sleep on one night out of every two is sufficient

bools.name: wgfDonIsNineMinusAC
bools.comment: the donning time in rounds is 9 minus the armor class of the armor being worn

bools.name: wgfPlateAddTwoRounds
bools.comment: any plate armor adds 2 rounds to the calculated donning figure

bools.name: wgfUnaidedAddFiveRounds
bools.comment: field plate or full plate donned without help takes an extra 5 rounds

bools.name: wgfDoffHalfTime
bools.comment: taking off armor can be done in half the time required to put it on

bools.name: wgfLeatherDoffHalfRound
bools.comment: a character gets out of his leather gear in one half of one round

bools.name: wgfFireNotIntegral
bools.comment: a campfire is not an integral part of a campsite, though characters usually want a small fire when they stop for the night

bools.name: wgfCookingIncidental
bools.comment: the cooking function of a fire is incidental for these rules: food from hunting or foraging is just as edible raw

bools.name: wgfPlantsPoisonousRaw
bools.comment: some plants are poisonous unless they are cooked, so characters who do not habitually cook may regret their indiscretion

bools.name: wgfWarmthPrimary
bools.comment: the primary function of a campfire is to provide warmth

bools.name: wgfWarmthLifeOrDeath
bools.comment: the warmth of a campfire can sometimes make the difference between life and death

bools.name: wgfFuelGatherTurns
bools.comment: the fuel value is how many turns a single character needs to gather enough wood or other combustible material for an eight-hour burn

bools.name: wgfAssumesFirewood
bools.comment: the fuel values assume that firewood is available in the environment
